definition: A temporary method that reduces the effect of an incident or problem without removing its underlying cause.
rationale: Use this noun for an interim method that reduces service impact while the problem or cause remains unresolved. A workaround can restore service or reduce impact, but it is not the root-cause fix.

allowed.text: The workaround routes new orders to the secondary service while the problem is investigated.
allowed.rationale: Names an interim method and the continuing investigation of the problem.

not_allowed.text: The workaround removed the database fault.
not_allowed.rationale: Conflates an interim method with removal of the underlying cause.

locator.section: What skills will you acquire? / Problem management

criteria: Verify that the noun identifies an interim method that reduces the effect of an incident or problem.
Keep the noun distinct from a permanent resolution, a root-cause fix, and the analyzed problem or known error.
Confirm that the inspected Problem Management page supports the use of workarounds but does not establish a complete universal glossary definition.
